profile.summary: Fleetworks Inc. is a company that repairs and maintains heavy-duty trucks, trailers and equipment for businesses and public fleets. It offers shop repair, mobile truck repair, preventive maintenance and inspections from locations in Oakland, Santa Fe Springs and Riverside, California.
